archetypes.name: argv-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Diff removes design round-cap argv/env plumbing while preserving implement round-cap conduit, so cross-script caller/callee contracts are high risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate shell argv and environment contract changes across design and implement review scripts. Check that removed --round-cap handling is not still passed by any design caller, while the implement review-and-fix --round-cap conduit remains intact where intended. Verify unknown-option, usage, and exit-code behavior stays compatible with callers and harnesses. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: loop-state
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 loop cap semantics changed from degraded-round inflation to a hard ceiling, affecting resume, cap-hit, and degraded-round boundary behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the Step 5 loop state machine after removing degraded-round cap inflation. Focus on boundary cases around STARTING_ROUND, mav-resume-past-cap, cap-hit, EFFECTIVE_ROUND_CAP emission, degraded-round markers, and prior-round artifact probing. Check for off-by-one errors or stale diagnostic/envelope fields after the cap becomes a fixed value. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: docs-harness-sync
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes a helper and updates many docs/tests, so stale Makefile shard entries, pins, or public prose could leave contradictory behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate consistency among deleted helper files, Makefile registrations, harness shards, shell tests, and public documentation. Look for stale references to LARCH_DESIGN_ROUND_CAP, lib-implement-round-cap, degraded-round inflation, or design --round-cap, while allowing the intended implement --round-cap conduit. Check that doc mirrors preserve pinned phrases such as the review panel wording where required. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
